services.desc: Come check out the American Shaolin Kung Fu beginner class for a FREE trial! Your martial arts journey starts here. At American Shaolin Kung Fu, Master Shi Yan Feng and our dedicated instructors welcome individuals of all ages and skill levels. Here, you will not only have the unique opportunity to develop your physical strength, flexibility, and overall fitness but also to work on mental discipline and focus while mastering the foundational skills and techniques of Kung Fu. These include a variety of powerful punches, dynamic kicks, and stable stances and forms that are crucial to the martial art.
